A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 25-page versions of Measuring Diversity in Synthetic Datasets, including Appendices A–E. Full text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of the same DCScore research.

before.justification: v2 reports original correlation, computation-time, downstream-training and robustness experiments in Section 5 and Appendix D, including numerical outcomes in Tables 3–8 and 10–14.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical outcomes in Section 5 and Appendix D, including correlation measurements, runtime comparisons, classification accuracies and sensitivity analyses.

M1.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same representation, kernel-similarity, softmax classification and trace-based diversity calculation. No proposed component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same generated text-classification and story-completion data, SST2/Yelp/AG News and their AttrPrompt variants, and colored MNIST. Dataset and scenario coverage in Section 5 and Appendix C is unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: Distinct-n, K-means Inertia and VendiScore in the main comparisons, and FKEA-Vendi and FKEA-RKE in Appendix D.2. The visual-modality and duplicate-sample comparisons retain VendiScore.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix C retain identical generation settings, model sizes, sample counts, splits, preprocessing, metrics and training budgets. Figure 2's visual adjustment does not change the depicted evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: Temperature sensitivity, duplicate-sample robustness, downstream-training analyses, and embedding/kernel sensitivity experiments are unchanged in Sections 5.4–5.5 and Appendix D.3–D.5.

E5.justification: Both retain the same five-repeat evaluations, random-seed disclosures and uncertainty reporting. Appendix D.1 still specifies five repetitions with means and standard deviations; no statistical reporting practice is added or removed.

E6.justification: All empirical table entries and plotted results match, including Tables 3–8 and 10–14. For example, Table 7 retains zero-shot accuracies of 89.10, 89.70 and 90.37 under the same generation temperatures.

T1.justification: The DCScore definition, four axioms, complexity analysis and Appendix B proofs are identical. The introductory distinct-n explanation is shortened, but its mathematical definition remains unchanged in Appendix E.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements and conclusion retain the same claims about classification-based diversity evaluation, axiom satisfaction, correlation with diversity pseudo-truths and computational efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of evaluator agreement, training difficulty and kernel-dependent efficiency are unchanged. Both retain the stated limitation that DCScore cannot directly evaluate multimodal data such as image-text pairs.

D1.justification: Appendix C preserves the same prompts, embedding model, hyperparameters, RoBERTa/LoRA training details and GPU specifications. The code-access statement and repository address also remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, Section 2 and Appendix A are unchanged. The condensed introductory n-gram passage retains its citation and the same positioning relative to semantic diversity evaluation.

P1.justification: v3 condenses the introductory n-gram/distinct-n explanation and updates author affiliations, adding Shanghai Jiao Tong University for Peilin Zhao and renumbering affiliations. The remaining prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The first page is reflowed: the Introduction begins at the top of the right column, with adjusted abstract and affiliation spacing. Figure 2 is slightly resized and repositioned while retaining its labels and connections; other displays are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 makes localized affiliation, wording and layout adjustments, including Figure 2. The omitted introductory distinct-n explanation remains in Appendix E, while the method, proofs, empirical evidence, reproducibility information and limitations are unchanged. Overall quality remains essentially stable.
